What's your return and refund policy?
Our return policy is a 30-day return/refund policy for orders placed on Nanuk.com.
Returns and refunds
You may return an item for a refund or replacement if you are not completely satisfied.
The product must be in perfect condition or new, resalable condition.
All accessories and original packaging must be included.
Proof of purchase is required.
Returns must be authorized by us first, and a Return Authorization must be issued before you ship the item back.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method after the return is inspected.
Shipping costs for returns
Return shipping is the buyer's responsibility.
If the return is due to an error on our side, we will cover the return shipping.
Important limits
This policy applies only to orders placed directly on Nanuk.com.
Orders purchased from third-party sellers or authorized retailers are subject to that seller's return policy.
This policy is not applicable to wholesale orders.
